+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Parameter
+
+
+class TrimEnvironmentResult(Parameter):
+    """A :class:`Parameter` that strips leading and trailing whitespace
+    from the value read from the environment.
+    """
+
+    def resolve_envvar_value(self, ctx: Context) -> str | None:
+        if self.envvar is None:
+            return None
+
+        if isinstance(self.envvar, str):
+            rv = os.environ.get(self.envvar)
+
+            if rv:
+                return rv.strip()
+        else:
+            for envvar in self.envvar:
+                rv = os.environ.get(envvar)
+
+                if rv:
+                    return rv.strip()
+
+        return None

+import click
+from click.trim_environment_result import TrimEnvironmentResult
+
+
+class TrimArgument(TrimEnvironmentResult, click.Argument):
+    pass
+
+
+def _ctx():
+    return click.Context(click.Command("cli"))
+
+
+def test_strips_single_envvar(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TEST_TRIM", "  value \n")
+    param = TrimArgument(["a"], envvar="TEST_TRIM")
+    assert param.resolve_envvar_value(_ctx()) == "value"
+
+
+def test_first_truthy_raw_value_selected(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TEST_TRIM_A", "")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TEST_TRIM_B", "   ")
+    monkeypatch.setenv("TEST_TRIM_C", "c")
+    param = TrimArgument(["a"], envvar=["TEST_TRIM_A", "TEST_TRIM_B", "TEST_TRIM_C"])
+    assert param.resolve_envvar_value(_ctx()) == ""
+
+
+def test_missing_returns_none(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("TEST_TRIM", raising=False)
+    assert TrimArgument(["a"], envvar="TEST_TRIM").resolve_envvar_value(_ctx()) is None
+    assert TrimArgument(["a"]).resolve_envvar_value(_ctx()) is None
